_source: REIMS/CESSNA F172M Flight Manual, Edition 1 Sept 1972, Rev 6 Aug 1975 (trn-docs/SXASV_AFM.pdf; SX-ASG's copy is the same edition), plus Aeroclub Mesogeion MD 4.3 loading sheet and MD 4.4 performance log. Units: kg, m, L, kt, ft.

fuel._source: AFM 5-2 Table 1 (total 159 L / 42 US gal); 2-3 (7.50 L unusable each tank); 5-2 range data (144 L standard, 182 L long-range usable); MD 4.3 (AVGAS 0.72 kg/L, MOGAS 0.75 kg/L)

massBalance._source: AFM 2-2 Centre of gravity location and loading limits; MD 4.3 station arms. Datum: forward face of firewall. Arms in metres.

envelopes._comment: Polygons of [cg arm m, mass kg]. Forward limit is linear between the two points given in the AFM; the lower edge (600 kg) is the bottom of the AFM chart.

utility._note: AFM utility category: 2000 lb = 907 kg; forward limit 35.5 in = 0.90 m at 2000 lb (on the normal-category forward line), aft limit 40.5 in = 1.03 m.

takeoff._source: AFM 5-8 Table 5: take-off distance, flaps retracted, hard surface runway. Distances in m: [ground run, total to clear 15 m obstacle].
takeoff.source: AFM 5-8 Table 5: take-off distance, flaps retracted, hard surface runway
notes: Increase the distance by 10% for each 15 °C above standard temperature for the altitude.
Dry grass: increase both distances by 7% of the total-to-clear-15-m figure.

landing._source: AFM 5-9 Table 6: landing distance, flaps 40°, power off, zero wind, hard surface runway. Distances in m: [ground roll, total to clear 15 m obstacle].
landing.source: AFM 5-9 Table 6: landing distance, flaps 40°, power off, zero wind, hard surface runway
notes: Decrease distances by 10% for each 5 kt headwind.
Increase the distance by 10% for each 15 °C above standard temperature.
Dry grass: increase both distances by 20% of the total-to-clear-15-m figure.
Short grass: up to 5 in; long grass: 5–10 in. Grass longer than 10 in, and runways with RWYCC 4 or less, are prohibited.

stallIasKt._source: AFM 5-7 Table 4, power off, 1043 kg, by angle of bank 0/20/40/60°
